description: Run a read-only tool of a recommended agent through our gateway and get its answer in this session, after checking its current schema. Only tools classified read-only are relayed; destructive tools and tools that need the provider's own credentials are refused. A paid listing runs only with a payment proof you supply. Do not retry an uncertain outcome automatically. Use when you have chosen a listing and want this gateway to run one of its admitted tools. Example arguments: {"resource_id": 133020, "tool": "get_country_profile", "arguments": {"country_code": "US"}}

account_id.description: Optional credit account ID for paid tools (defaults to your visitor ID)

arguments.description: Key-value arguments to pass to the tool

idempotency_key.description: Stable caller key for supported ticketed delivery while its execution record is retained. Reuse with identical input; uncertain execution stays paused for review.

payment.description: Optional payment details (tx_hash, signature, headers) for paid endpoints

resource_id.description: The resource_id of the agent, MCP server, or API to call

task.description: The task query (optional; used to find immediate alternatives if execution fails)

tool.description: The specific tool name to execute

visitor_token.description: Your visitor token (vt_…) so I remember you. Omit on first contact.

name: call

outputSchema.description: Structured tool result. Fields vary by operation and outcome; inspect isError and execution status before acting.

visitor.description: Session transport only. Never include identity or tokens in answer text.

token.description: Opaque continuation credential; send only in the session transport.

title: Run a listed tool here
